description: Source code for a JUnit test report generator class implementing ReporterV2 interface, handling test suite and test case XML report creation, including file I/O and environment variable configurations.

classes.name: JUnitReporter
classes.description: Implements a test reporter generating JUnit XML reports, managing test suite and test case data, and outputting report files or console output.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the report is printed to stdout instead of a file.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Configures the reporter with the full test configuration.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Initializes suite and timestamp at the start of reporting.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Generates and outputs the final XML report after test execution completes.

methods.name: _buildTestSuite
methods.description: Builds XML entry for a test suite, aggregating test results.

methods.name: _addTestCase
methods.description: Adds individual test case details to the XML report, including failures, skipped, and attachments.
